survey: A yellow-orange portable music player shaped like a rounded square block. It floats tilted: the face is turned a little clockwise and away, so a thick orange side shows along the right and bottom edges. That means the camera is slightly above-left and in front. On the face there is a large white round play button with an orange triangle. It sits slightly squashed, matching the face's tilt. Below it is a row of three small LEDs (red, orange, green) that slopes down to the right, parallel to the body's tilted top and bottom edges. Under the LEDs is one small white round button. A white jack plug rises from the top-right edge, and its cable loops right and down behind the body. The cable comes out lower right and splits into two earbuds at the bottom. Each earbud is a rounded shell with an oval opening, both turned toward the viewer at matching angles. There is no ground plane, and every part is seen from the same slightly-high, front-left viewpoint.
